_note: From docs/car-stats.pdf. Stats are 1-5 and add up to 12 per car. Types match the rows of public/cars.png.

formula.name: Formula
formula.title: The Speed Demon
formula.strength: Highest top speed, unbeatable on long straights.
formula.weakness: Slow off the line and slides wide on tight turns.

sports.name: Sports
sports.title: The All-Rounder
sports.strength: Balanced everywhere, easy for new players to pick up.
sports.weakness: Doesn't beat the others at any one thing.

hatch.name: Hatchback
hatch.title: The Zippy One
hatch.strength: Quickest to speed up and the tightest turning.
hatch.weakness: Low top speed and gets knocked around in bumps.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.title: The Tank
pickup.strength: Heavy: shoves other cars aside and shrugs off hits.
pickup.weakness: Slowest to speed up and sluggish in corners.
